description: This file defines the 'SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport' command class, which is part of the 'thingsearch' sudo command suite in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create instances from JSON data, manages command headers, and overrides standard object methods. It is used for retrieving a namespace report without authorization.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport
classes.description: Final class representing a command to retrieve a namespace report without authorization, extending AbstractCommand and implementing ThingSearchSudoCommand.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport from a JSON string or JSON object along with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated DittoHeaders.
